messages.text: Hello Helium team! I received my link for the early Harlo Lotto. Will the $20 early deposit be applied as well? I only see the $599 at check out.
Read the harlo h15 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual
Handed to the team · No rule or tool data on how the early bird deposit is credited against the H15 e

I can see your $20 Harlo L. Early Bird Deposit on order Shop····, and it's paid.

What I can't tell you is how that $20 gets applied to the $599 early price. I don't have a rule for it, and I'd rather not guess with your money. I've passed your question to the team, along with your order number. Someone will get back to you with the answer, and it'll come to your email if you leave the chat.

Is there anything else about the H15 Dual I can help with in the meantime?
Only other question is if the Harlo Lotto has an estimated power usage yet?

If the early link you got is for the Harlo H15 Dual, the listing puts it at about 500 W. That's an estimate from the product page, not a measured figure at the wall.

For that, the listing gives about 15 TH/s on Bitcoin (SHA-256) plus 1.08 GH/s on Scrypt for Dogecoin and Litecoin. The power supply is built in, and it's rated around 50 dB.

There's no per-mode breakdown yet, like the eco and turbo figures some of our other miners have. Want me to ask the team for one?
